task: Keep the global Proof-or-Stop executable working after dist rebuilds and diagnose global runtime drift accurately.
outcome: After npm --prefix packages/main run build, packages/main/dist/cli.js has mode 0755 and proof-or-stop --version succeeds; proof-or-stop doctor prints the compiled runtime version or version=unknown when that probe fails.
facts: TypeScript emits fresh dist entrypoints without executable bits.
The global executable may be a symlink to packages/main/dist/cli.js, so replacing that target with mode 0644 breaks the command.
promoteDist validates and restores staging bin targets before evicting the working dist.
Final symlinks and intermediate-directory symlink escapes must not be followed by chmod.
A failed compiled-version probe is not evidence for the package manifest version.
constraints: Use only node: built-ins in scripts/promote-dist.mjs.
Preserve atomic promotion and leave the old dist intact when staging validation fails.
Treat only ENOENT as a benign absent-target condition.
Doctor remains read-only and must not repair host state.
Story metadata and implementation remain English.
